questions.solution: Step i and ii is the hyboration reaction, where diborane adds to an alkane in presence of H2O2. This is according to anti-Markownikoff's rule. Step iii is the elimination reaction, where H2O is eliminated and leads to formation of 2 alkanes. The major product is according to Satzeff rule.
